chunks: From him, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who has slaves and bequeaths their manumission for one-third of them, he said: 'Ali (peace be upon him) would cast lots among them.'
ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali determine which slaves to free when a master bequeathed one-third of them?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the prophetic precedent of using *qur'ah* (casting lots) to resolve ambiguity in bequests, specifically when a master wishes to free a fraction of his slaves. It highlights Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) practical application of this method to ensure equitable and random selection among the slaves, a principle later utilized in Shia jurisprudence for dividing undivided assets or determining priority in obligations.
